original_ai_output.title_zh: 疑似暴徒袭击NDC支持者，扰乱拉各斯Peter Obi市民大会
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚拉各斯州一场为总统候选人Peter Obi举办的市民大会上，疑似暴徒袭击了尼日利亚民主大会党（NDC）支持者。袭击发生于11月12日周四上午11时左右，地点在Ikeja的Oregun，袭击者持械闯入会场，导致会议中断、参与者逃离。据报道，袭击者携带砍刀、棍棒和石块，试图进入主会场时遭到NDC支持者抵抗。目前该事件为单一来源报道。

key_facts.fact: 疑似暴徒袭击了NDC支持者，扰乱为Peter Obi举办的市民大会
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: SUSPECTED thugs have attacked supporters of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC) during a town hall meeting organised for the party's presidential candidate, Peter Obi, in Lagos State.

key_facts.fact: 袭击发生于11月12日周四上午11时左右，地点在Ikeja的Oregun
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The attack, which occurred around 11am on Thursday, November 12, at Oregun, Ikeja, disrupted proceedings and forced participants to flee as the attackers invaded the venue with weapons.

key_facts.fact: 袭击者携带砍刀、棍棒和石块，试图进入主会场时遭到NDC支持者抵抗
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The hoodlums, armed with cutlasses, cudgels and stones, attempted to gain access to the main hall but were initially resisted by NDC supporters

key_facts.fact: 据报袭击者从Oregun的Kudirat Abiola路方向接近
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The newspaper reported seeing the attackers approach from Kudirat Abiola Road in Oregun.

uncertainties: 袭击者身份为疑似暴徒，尚未确认

袭击者是否携带枪支仅为据报讨论内容，未获确认
